title: Broken Bell
description: A bell with a cracked tongue stands in the training hall. The abbot asks you to learn why small details matter by tending to it.

choices.text: Carefully adjust the bell and test its tone.
Leave it cracked; it's still a bell.

title: Morning Kettle
description: The abbot asks you to keep the morning kettle at a steady simmer — a test of attention and rhythm.

choices.text: Tend the kettle carefully until it's just right.

title: Row of Bowls
description: A neat row of bowls needs arranging by size and cleanliness. The abbot uses this to teach order.

choices.text: Arrange and polish each bowl carefully.
Throw them in order of convenience.

title: Bamboo Sweeps
description: The abbot demonstrates a sweeping motion; he asks you to copy it until the movement is calm and precise.

title: Whistling Bamboo
description: The Abbot gestures to a grove of bamboo and demonstrates a breathing drill that makes the stalks hum — an exercise in focus and timing.

effects.add_event_log: You bow and decline the Abbot's offer, keeping to your own path for now.

title: Whistling Bamboo (Recap)
description: The abbot asks you to recall the whistling bamboo exercise and apply it to a new row of poles.

choices.text: Apply the whistling rhythm to each pole.

title: Iron Palm Drill
description: The Abbot demonstrates an iron palm conditioning drill. He offers you a guided set of strikes to build resilience.

choices.label: Endure the patience of the drill

effects.add_event_log: You ask for a brief rest; the Abbot nods and lets you breathe.

title: Iron Palm Drill (Recap)
description: The abbot sets you on a slow iron-palm drill to feel the edge of control and restraint.

choices.text: Perform the drill with steady force.

title: Morning Kneeling
description: Before dawn the Abbot leads a simple kneeling ritual to sharpen humility and endurance. He invites you to join.

effects.add_event_log: You watch the ritual, feeling a slow calm settle over you.

title: Morning Kneeling (Recap)
description: Kneel with the monks and learn to steady your back and breath; the abbot watches your humility.

choices.text: Kneel and focus on breath and posture.

title: Moonlit Forms
description: Under the moon the Abbot guides you through fluid forms designed to align breath and motion. It feels like learning to move as one organism.

effects.add_event_log: You take your leave, storing the memory of the Abbot's form for quiet practice.

title: Moonlit Forms (Recap)
description: Under moonlight the abbot asks you to practice forms slowly and with purpose.

title: Silent Observation
description: The abbot asks you to sit and observe without acting — a test of presence and restraint.

choices.text: Fidget and glance around; it's boring.

title: Sweeping Endurance
description: Sweep the courtyard until your arms tire — the abbot gauges your willingness to sustain small, repeated acts.

choices.text: Sweep steadily until the courtyard is clean.
Do a quick pass and stop.

title: Kettledrum Patience
description: The abbot asks you to keep a slow, steady rhythm on a kettledrum for an hour — a test of patience and focus.

choices.text: Keep the rhythm steadily, matching the abbot's breathing.
Let your mind wander and play when it feels natural.

title: Morning Kata Alignment
description: The abbot requests you to repeat a simple set of forms while focusing on alignment over power.

choices.text: Move slowly and emphasize posture and balance.
Rush through the motions to finish quickly.

title: Silent Kettling
description: A small iron kettle must be warmed and poured without a sound. The abbot watches for care and humility.

choices.text: Perform the task with care and total silence.
Hurry and get it done before it cools.

title: Sweeping Reflection
description: At dusk you are asked to sweep the outer courtyard while reflecting on a teaching the abbot whispers.

choices.text: Sweep slowly and reflect on the abbot's instruction.
Finish quickly and be done with it.

title: Morning Sun Circulation
description: The Grandmaster asks you to practice a gentle circulation at dawn to awaken the limbs without force.

title: Balanced Step
description: You are instructed to walk a measured line on the stone path, keeping balance as the Grandmaster watches.

title: Water Breathing
description: A basin of cold water is set before you; the Grandmaster asks you to breathe in time with its ripples.

choices.label: Match your breathing to the water

title: Silk Thread Focus
description: A length of silk is suspended; the Grandmaster asks you to hold it steady as a test of fine control.

title: Breathing Ripple
description: The Grandmaster instructs a subtle breathing ripple to carry power through the limbs — a lesson in inner flow.

effects.add_event_log: The Grandmaster smiles and demonstrates a simpler circulation instead.

title: Silk-Thread Saber
description: A practiced cut so light it feels like pulling a thread — the Master teases the mechanics of economy and precision.

effects.add_event_log: The Master offers a tiny correction that changes the geometry of your cut.

title: Hidden Water Step
description: The Master demonstrates a footwork that flows like water, shifting weight invisibly — practice in evasive balance.

effects.add_event_log: You skip the lesson, noting the Master's quiet smile.

title: Meditative Feint
description: In a controlled exercise the Grandmaster shows how a clear mind can hide intent — a feint that begins with an empty breath.

effects.add_event_log: You watch the Grandmaster and file away the pattern for later practice.

title: Bristle Stance Test
description: The master asks you to hold a low stance while shifting weight like bristles in wind.

choices.label: Hold the stance despite the ache

title: Sparring: Slow Motion
description: You spar slowly with a senior disciple to learn control over momentum rather than speed.

title: Threaded Water Form
description: Practice a flowing form that guides force like a thread through water.

choices.label: Hold rigid and correct posture later

title: Moon Tide Alignment
description: At night you perform a sequence to align breathing with the moon's calm rhythm.

title: Hidden Path Breath
description: You are led along a narrow mountain path and instructed to breathe calmly to maintain footing.

title: Final Water Gesture
description: A culminating exercise: a small, precise water gesture to demonstrate everything learned.

title: Dawn Boil of Tears
description: The Matron asks you to collect dew at dawn and use it to brew a mild restorative tea — a lesson in gentle attention.

choices.label: Collect dew carefully and brew the tea
Leave the dew for the plants

title: Silk Bandage Practice
description: You are taught to apply silk bandages with even tension — small hands, steady care.

title: Bell and Salve
description: The Matron strikes a small bell and asks you to prepare a salve while listening to its resonance — patience and skill combined.

title: Lotus Breathing
description: You practice a slow breathing technique while holding a lotus petal; the Matron emphasizes gentleness.

title: Purifying Sutra
description: The Matron hums an old sutra while demonstrating a healing pass — a small lesson in channeling restorative qi.

effects.add_event_log: You bow and decline the Matron's tutoring for now.

title: Tenacious Guard
description: She shows a bracing stance that supports others; the Matron insists you hold the pose until your limbs tremble.

effects.add_event_log: She nods and guides you into a gentler variation, instructing patience over pride.

title: Restorative Forms
description: The Matron demonstrates a flowing set designed to open wounds and mend chi — gentle, precise, and restorative.

effects.add_event_log: You observe the Matron's hands; the motion feels like sewing wind into skin.

title: Soul Mending
description: In a quiet alcove the Matron speaks of wounds the eyes cannot see and guides you through a meditative mending.

effects.add_event_log: You step back, keeping the Matron's words for later.

title: Silent Heal Test
description: A simulated wound is presented; you must tend it in silence to show focus and empathy.

choices.label: Tend it in silence with steady hands

title: Sacred Band
description: You are given a worn band to mend; the Matron watches how you sew patience into it.

choices.label: Quick patch to make it usable

title: Mending Song
description: The Matron hums as you stitch; she judges not speed but the care woven into each stitch.

choices.label: Stitch carefully in time with the song
Finish quickly without attention to rhythm

title: Calm Wind Gesture
description: A small hand gesture calms an incense flame; the Matron asks you to replicate it precisely.

choices.label: Approximate it and call it close enough

title: Moonlit Salve
description: At night you prepare a salve by moonlight; the Matron watches how you preserve its potency.

choices.label: Keep the salve's potency with careful methods

title: Parting Bless
description: Before you leave the Matron offers a small blessing and asks you to reflect on compassion in practice.

choices.label: Decline politely and continue your path

title: Mountain Breath
description: The Eldest asks you to breathe deeply and feel the mountain's rhythm — a primer in grounding.

title: Stone Posture
description: Hold a rooted posture while the Eldest adjusts your stance — strength through stillness.

title: Rock Lineage
description: The Eldest tells a short lineage tale and asks you to reflect on what steadiness means in practice.

title: Tremor: Listen
description: Stand barefoot and sense faint tremors; the Eldest trains you to read subtle shifts.

title: Earth Sense
description: The Eldest teaches a grounding drill to feel the mountain beneath your feet — a lesson in stability and patience.

effects.add_event_log: You watch the Eldest and sense the slow patience of the mountain.

title: Formation Basics
description: He sketches a simple formation on the ground and explains how bodies and qi interlock to make a mountain move.

effects.add_event_log: You watch the lines of the formation and feel a new sense of placement.

title: Element Tuning
description: The Eldest shows how to tune yourself to a patch of earth and listen for its subtle shifts — a primer on elemental attunement.

effects.add_event_log: You step back and let the mountain's silence teach you.

title: Terrain Mastery
description: A short field test across rocky slopes challenges your footing; the Eldest coaches you through adjusting to each step.

effects.add_event_log: You delay the test, promising to return when you are steadier.

title: Gate Formation
description: Form a small rock gate with fellow disciples to test coordination under the Eldest's watch.

title: Ridge Endurance
description: A short endurance trial along a ridge tests steady breath and footwork.

title: Pillar Shift
description: Move a small pillar precisely to align a formation; the Eldest watches for deliberate movement.

title: Vale Listen
description: Sit at the valley's edge and listen for the echo of the land; the Eldest tests your awareness.

title: Summit Footing
description: A short climb to a summit requires careful footwork; the Eldest values steady feet.

title: Last Stone Bow
description: Before you leave, the Eldest asks for a respectful bow at the last standing stone — a sign of humility.

title: Steep Ridge Lesson
description: The master gestures to a sheer ridge and asks you to find your footing. It's a test of balance and focus.

choices.text: Accept the lesson and climb the ridge.

title: Willow Stance
description: You are shown a soft, yielding stance that bends without breaking. The master watches for stubbornness.

title: Hidden Edge Footwork
description: A footwork drill on narrow paths sharpens your awareness. The master times your steps.

choices.text: Step away from the risky edge.

title: Mirror of Blades
description: The master sets two blades in parallel and asks you to move between them in rhythm.

title: Dawn Duel Exercise
description: At first light the master invites you to a sparring drill meant to temper your reflexes.

title: Edge Control
description: The Swordmaster demonstrates subtle edge angles that make a cut decisive. He asks you to practice a simple parry and return.

effects.add_event_log: You watch the Swordmaster's motion and see how small shifts change outcome.

title: Lantern Balance
description: Balancing a lit lantern while moving tests calm hands; the master times your steadiness.

title: Timing
description: He times a strike and asks you to meet it; timing here is the blade's true companion.

effects.add_event_log: You hesitate and the Swordmaster nods; timing must come from within.

title: Bamboo Ring Drill
description: A flowing drill with bamboo rings teaches timing and coordination.

title: Counterstrike
description: An exercise in reading the opponent's intent; the Swordmaster guides a simple counter that punishes overreach.

effects.add_event_log: You decline, promising to return after more practice.

title: Instant Finish
description: A short drill that emphasizes ending a fight cleanly; the Swordmaster's lesson is brief and exact.

effects.add_event_log: You hold back, noting the Swordmaster's calm approval.

title: Swallow Step Timing
description: A lesson on timing: move like a swallow and land light as a feather.

title: Peak Breathing
description: High on the peak the air is thin; the master guides a breathing exercise to ground you.

title: Last Shadow Turn
description: A closing exercise where you must mirror a shadow's last motion perfectly.

title: Wind Slice Skill
description: The master demonstrates a quick slicing motion that catches the wind; you practice the form.

title: Stone Return Block
description: A defensive drill taught to return an incoming strike into the ground; the master corrects your posture.

title: Moonlit Step and Pause
description: Under the moon the master teaches a step-and-pause technique to find openings.

title: Blessing of the Peak
description: The master offers a quiet blessing and a final corrective to your form; a closing of lessons.

title: Broken Cup Story
description: The chief tells a small tale about a broken cup that taught him thrift and wit.

title: Shared Stew
description: You help ladle stew for the group; the chief watches how you share.

title: Finger Trick
description: The chief shows a sleight-of-hand trick and offers to teach a simple misdirection.

title: Patchwork Shawl
description: An old shawl needs mending; the chief invites you to stitch and hear his advice.

title: Nomad Trap
description: The Chief demonstrates a simple trap and the network of scouts who use it — a lesson in preparation and community tactics.

effects.add_event_log: You decline and the Chief shrugs, already moving to the next story.

title: Sneak Path Practice
description: A short stealth exercise to move quietly between tents.

title: Map of Hidden Routes
description: He unfurls a crude map and offers to show you unseen routes; knowledge for those who care.

choices.text: Follow him and study the routes.

title: Network Building
description: He outlines how favors, food, and stories bind people; you practice a small act of service to learn the lesson.

effects.add_event_log: You watch as the Chief weaves favors into obligations and back into protection.

title: Ambush Basics
description: A compact lesson in silent positioning and timing; the Chief teaches how to make noise somewhere else while the real work happens.

effects.add_event_log: You sit out the ambush drill, taking in the Chief's sly grin.

title: Ring Story Challenge
description: He sets a small challenge — tell a concise true story to earn a ring as token.

title: Improvised Arsenal
description: The Chief shows how a simple stick and string can become a weapon — ingenuity more than steel matters here.

effects.add_event_log: You refuse the improvised tool, preferring cleaner weapons, and the Chief laughs.

title: Sharpen Thoughts
description: A casual riddle and the chief observes how you think under pressure.

title: Night Watch
description: Take a turn on watch and show your reliability to the chief.

title: Last Cookie Trade
description: A small barter for a treat — the chief tests your fairness in trade.

title: Shared Spoon Oath
description: The chief asks you to share a single spoon between two bowls as a small test of trust and patience.

title: Streetwise Lesson
description: He gives a short lesson on reading faces and crowds — small skills for staying safe and finding opportunity.

title: Traveling Story Trade
description: He offers a small trinket in exchange for a travel tip — a brief test of generosity and knowledge.

choices.text: Share a helpful travel tip and accept the trinket.

title: Parting Smoke and Luck
description: Before you leave the camp the chief offers a pinch of ceremonial smoke and a short word of luck.
